{"Name": "all-network-direction-local", "DisplayName": "Local Network Direction (Loopback)", "Description": "Enrich network_direction as 'local' when either src or dest is a loopback address", "Condition": "exists(src_ip, dest_ip) && (src_network_type = 'loopback' || dest_network_type = 'loopback')", "Map": [{"Field": "network_direction", "Value": "'local'"}]}

{"Name": "all-network-direction-inbound", "DisplayName": "Inbound Network Direction", "Description": "Enrich network_direction as 'inbound' when public IP communicates to private IP (WAN -> LAN)", "Condition": "exists(src_ip, dest_ip) && src_network_type = 'WAN' && dest_network_type = 'LAN'", "Map": [{"Field": "network_direction", "Value": "'inbound'"}]}

{"Name": "all-network-direction-outbound", "DisplayName": "Outbound Network Direction", "Description": "Enrich network_direction as 'outbound' when private IP communicates to public IP (LAN -> WAN)", "Condition": "exists(src_ip, dest_ip) && src_network_type = 'LAN' && dest_network_type = 'WAN'", "Map": [{"Field": "network_direction", "Value": "'outbound'"}]}

{"Name": "all-network-direction-internal", "DisplayName": "Internal Network Direction", "Description": "Enrich network_direction as 'internal' when private IP communicates to private IP (LAN -> LAN)", "Condition": "exists(src_ip, dest_ip) && src_network_type = 'LAN' && dest_network_type = 'LAN'", "Map": [{"Field": "network_direction", "Value": "'internal'"}]}

{"Name": "all-network-direction-external", "DisplayName": "External Network Direction", "Description": "Enrich network_direction as 'external' when public IP communicates to public IP (WAN -> WAN)", "Condition": "exists(src_ip, dest_ip) && src_network_type = 'WAN' && dest_network_type = 'WAN'", "Map": [{"Field": "network_direction", "Value": "'external'"}]}

{"Name": "all-network-direction-unknown", "DisplayName": "Unknown Network Direction", "Description": "Enrich network_direction as 'unknown' when direction cannot be determined (Special, multicast, anylocal, IPv6 edge cases)", "Condition": "exists(src_ip, dest_ip) && src_network_type != 'loopback' && dest_network_type != 'loopback' && (src_network_type = 'Special' || dest_network_type = 'Special')", "Map": [{"Field": "network_direction", "Value": "'unknown'"}]}

{"Name": "all-file-dir", "DisplayName": "Extract File Directory", "Description": "Extract directory path from file_path field", "Condition": "exists(file_path) && !exists(file_dir)", "Map": [{"Field": "file_dir", "Value": "extractFileDir(file_path)"}]}

{"Name": "all-file-name", "DisplayName": "Extract File Name", "Description": "Extract file name from file_path field", "Condition": "exists(file_path) && !exists(file_name)", "Map": [{"Field": "file_name", "Value": "extractFileName(file_path)"}]}

{"Name": "all-file-ext", "DisplayName": "Extract File Extension", "Description": "Extract file extension from file_path field", "Condition": "exists(file_path) && !exists(file_ext)", "Map": [{"Field": "file_ext", "Value": "extractFileExt(file_path)"}]}
